ul.li: Initial RFCXML Transformation and Governance Framework (draft-gerke-auth48-process-reform-00 to -01): Transformed the document to RFCXMLv3, introduced the two-stage freeze system, defined total recusal handling, and added the core procedural sections (Introduction, Security and IANA Considerations, and Section 5 on IESG, IAB, and RPC permissions and duties).

Expansion to Full Publication Process (draft-gerke-publication-process-reform-00 to -02): Broadened the scope beyond AUTH48 to the entire publication pipeline, split references into Normative and Informative categories, and added Section 6 (Stream Maintaining Bodies Considerations).
Timer Consolidation and Refinement (draft-gerke-publication-process-reform-03 to -06): Removed redundant timer rules in Section 3.1 and resolved logical ambiguities in Sections 2 and 4.

Datatracker Scope (RFC 6359) and Implementation Notes (draft-gerke-publication-process-reform-07): Added to the updates attribute, added Section 1.3 (Relationship to RFC 6359), and introduced Appendix B (Implementation Notes) and Appendix D (Notes to the RPC).

6-Level Publication Pipeline Restructuring (draft-gerke-publication-process-reform-10 to -13): Restructured Section 4 (The 6-Level Publication Pipeline), aligned Appendix B (Implementation Notes) accordingly, and removed textual redundancies.
